afcDesc: U.S.-manufactured fire protection valves, hydrants, hoses, extinguishers, connections, and suppression systems from American Fire Control.
afcDetail: American Fire Control is a United States manufacturer based in Orlando, Florida. Established as a family-owned business with a multi-generational legacy, AFC delivers premium fire protection valves, hydrants, department connections, hoses, extinguishers, flow devices, and suppression systems. Through S&PA, you can access AFC’s full product range for commercial and industrial life-safety applications.
afcFeature1: U.S. manufacturer with full control over production and quality
afcFeature2: Fire protection valves, hydrants, and department connections
afcFeature3: Hoses, extinguishers, and clean-agent suppression systems
honeywellDesc: Building, industrial, and process automation technologies plus connected life-safety solutions from Honeywell.
honeywellDetail: Honeywell Technologies supports operations where failure is not an option — from buildings and data centers to industrial plants. S&PA partners with Honeywell to deliver automation, safety, and connected systems that improve efficiency and resilience.
honeywellFeature3: Life safety, security, and OT cybersecurity outcomes

honeywellLineProcessDesc: Process control and energy innovation tools for complex industrial workflows.
spaDesc: MEP, facility, ICT, and fire-protection product solutions curated by S&PA for project delivery in Egypt.
spaDetail: S&PA selects and supplies globally recognized products aligned with our contracting and facility scopes. From electro-mechanical systems to ICT infrastructure and fire protection, our product offering supports design, supply, install, and maintain packages.
spaFeature1: MEP equipment selected for certified project delivery
spaFeature2: Facility and ICT products for critical workplaces
spaFeature3: Fire protection materials matched to approved designs
